text:
jules: quick RFC follow-up: instead of admitting whole long-gen requests, what if we admit in small 'parcels' and treat prefetch as evictable soft-state? should reduce peak KV/headroom and improve interleaving.

rina: sounds promising. are parcels fixed-size?

jules: not fixed. start with parcel_hint (e.g. 128 tokens) and allow adaptive sizing: grow if prior parcels are smooth, shrink if stalls.

marc: key tradeoffs: + lowers instantaneous memory and KV usage, + enables graceful partial fallbacks; - extra control-plane events, more telemetry, potential tiny reassembly tail.

samir: admission surface: do callers change?

jules: transparent. single request_id, runtime slices parcels. scheduler sees parcel-level credits. billing/metrics still roll up to request_id.

marc: how do we avoid wasted prefetch on cancellations?
jules: introduce a heartbeat/leash: parcel emits heartbeats while making progress. horizon prefetch expires if heartbeats miss. default: heartbeat=50ms, leash=200ms, require two misses to evict.

rina: can we multiplex parcels over one stream to avoid RPC explosion?
jules: yes. multiplex parcels on existing persistent streams. simple framed events: ParcelStart, ParcelHeartbeat, ParcelFinish.

marc: headroom ledger change: split credits into soft_prefetch_credit (evictable) and hard_exec_credit. prefetch reclaimed first under pressure. expose metrics: soft_prefetch_in_use, hard_exec_in_use.

samir: Dedicated/private customers: no silent cross-host moves. add parceling_mode: "strict" (no migration) vs "elastic" (allow best-effort fallback).

jules: good. also parcel-level fallback routing: remaining parcels can be routed to cheaper variant/region if permitted. reduces all-or-nothing failures.

infra-bot: feature-flag "parceling-experiment" enabled in staging 2024-06-30T11:00Z

marc: observability table suggestions: parcel_latency_histogram, parcel_reassembly_tail_ratio, parcel_prefetch_eviction_rate, parcel_active_gauge. alert if reassembly adds >10% to request P99.

rina: tests: jitter, client pause mid-request, cancel mid-parcel, high concurrency of tiny requests. add tracing that maps parcels -> request_id in traces.

samir: billing note: billing ties to emitted tokens. only attribute prefetched bytes if they cross lease_window and are later used; otherwise mark as waste in internal telemetry (no customer charge). add audit logs for cross-parcel hops.

marc: experiment plan: A/B on small models (2b) in staging -> canary on a few opt-in customers. metrics: P50/P95/P99 request latency, headroom_peak reduction, prefetch_waste_pct, connection_count. success: <2% P99 regression, 10-25% headroom reduction, prefetch_waste <5%. run 2 weeks.

jules: action items: (1) I'll update RFC with API sketch + telemetry and ledger doc, (2) infra to review admission knobs and mux protocol, (3) QA to add reassembly/cancel/jitter tests, (4) rollout: feature-flag -> opt-in -> canary -> GA.

samir: please include a Dedicated compatibility appendix and billing FAQ draft.

rina: also add adaptive parcel sizing as a post-canary opt. sketch: on-success++ size *= 1.5 up to cap; on-evict or miss size *= 0.5 min cap 16 tokens.

jules: will include. opening RFC PR today and tagging reviewers. :rocket:
